channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Javonte Green | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Javonte Green from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Alex Caruso on Javonte Green, Patrick Williams
item.description:
Alex Caruso on Patrick Williams wearing his jersey and Javonte Green donning a headband to celebrate his return:

“We have great chemistry. I think everybody on the team is pulling for whoever it is at the time that needs it. And tonight it was me.”

Alex Caruso on Javonte Green, Patrick Williams, Mar 13, 2022. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Javonte Green, Derrick Jones
item.description:
KC Johnson:Donovan on life without PWil:

“I think Derrick. I think Javonte. Obviously Alex, we’ve played smaller with 4 guards. A lot is going to be teams and matchups. I thought Lonzo when we were small did a pretty good on Randle, made his postups difficult. All those are viable options”

Billy Donovan on Javonte Green, Derrick Jones, Oct 29, 2021. Source: Twitter @KCJHoop.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Javonte Green
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“I’m getting old. Javonte is taking my spot, the high-flying (plays) and stuff like that.”

Jaylen Brown on Javonte Green, Nov 12, 2019. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.
